description:
Get a short-lived (15 min) HTTPS link to the media of one message (photo, voice note, audio, video, document) from LOCAL history. Requires message_id and chat (the chat JID, from whatsapp_messages). Returns { url, mime, size, name, expires_at }. The file is copied as-is to private storage for 7 days; ask again for a fresh link. On failure returns { success:false, error }: not_found (no media for that message), media_expired (WhatsApp no longer has the file), too_large (> 16 MB), unsupported_type, unsupported.

Bulk support: accepts message_ids for batched execution.
name: whatsapp_get_media
